additional_info.subject: ID0393295-DC/Si-D/DE -[4CaYkA] Outlet 1 Unavailable CRM:00796001013
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Breilmann KG
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N3 160331068
Charger ID/Serial No.:
4CaYkA
Problem Description: Outlet 1 Unavailable
We found that the charger is on FW v5.0.21, and there was an internal communication loss with the outlet, which resulted in Outlet 1 being unavailable for charging. After rebooting the charger, the outlet is now available for use.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 03/23/2023, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar

additional_info.subject: 0393295 - ID0393295-DC/Si-D/DE -[4CaYkA] Outlet 1 Unavailable CRM:00373000336
additional_info.body:
Hallo Herr Lindner,
mich hat Ihr Ticket soeben erreicht. Den Hinweisen unseres zentralen Supports entnehme ich, dass ein Neustart das Laden wieder ermöglicht hat. Was ich jedoch nicht herauslesen konnte, ist, ob auch mehr als 50kW zur Verfügung gestellt werden konnten.
Könnten Sie mir hier bitte noch mal einen Hinweis geben?
Und: konnten Sie den Charger mit verschiedenen Fahrzeugen und SoC's testen, damit wir sicher sein können, dass es nicht am Fahrzeug lag?
Danke Ihnen für Ihre Hilfe.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Sascha Theil
